6.22.5.title: Six new palettes

6.22.5.title: A smoother startup
6.22.5.detail: Budgetly uses a circular loading indicator and restores your chosen launcher or window icon.

6.22.5.title: A palette for each device
6.22.5.detail: Appearance and palette choices stay on this device and apply in Personal and shared Spaces.

6.22.4.title: Cleaner Android launcher icon

6.22.4.title: Midnight Blue & Mint

6.22.3.title: Palette changes keep Budgetly open

6.22.2.title: Better fit for Android launcher icons

6.22.1.title: Textured palette logos

6.22.0.title: A wallet logo for every palette

6.22.0.title: Cleaner settings and notifications

6.22.0.title: Simpler downloads and installation

6.21.1.title: Quicker access to balances and filters

6.21.1.title: Less clutter on daily screens
6.21.1.detail: Open the bell for attention items, and use the info buttons on Overview and Bank Inbox for extra details.

6.21.1.title: Consistent palette accents

6.21.0.title: Choose your Overview cards

6.21.0.title: Simpler money screens

6.20.0.title: A simpler Budgetly

6.20.0.title: Five color palettes

6.20.0.title: Bank Inbox alerts are easier to find

6.19.1.title: Wallet balances your way

6.19.1.title: A clearer walkthrough

6.19.0.title: A calmer Overview

6.18.1.title: Clearer Windows download
6.18.1.detail: The welcome page now offers one Windows download button without a second browser-install option.

6.18.0.title: Budgetly for Windows
6.18.0.detail: Download a standalone Windows installer from the welcome screen. The desktop app now checks for new installer versions and keeps its current interface available offline.

6.18.0.title: Wallet logo across devices
6.18.0.detail: The approved green wallet logo now appears in the Windows installer and app alongside the browser and Android branding.

6.17.1.title: Wallet logo shown consistently

6.17.0.title: A new Budgetly logo

6.16.0.title: Clearer offline status

6.16.0.title: Install on your PC

6.15.3.title: Adjustable bank duplicate checks

6.15.2.title: Clearer bank alert approval

6.15.1.title: A cleaner Android app icon
6.15.1.detail: Budgetly’s blue icon now fills the Android launcher shape without the extra white border.

6.15.0.title: Clearer transaction status
6.15.0.detail: See which workspace you are recording in, resume a saved draft, and distinguish server-confirmed entries from entries still waiting to sync.

6.15.0.title: Safer editing and recovery
6.15.0.detail: When another device changes a transaction first, compare the current values with your edits before choosing how to continue. Failed record refreshes now offer a clear retry.

6.15.0.title: Release layout checks
6.15.0.detail: The release quality check now covers narrow Android and desktop layouts and guards the initial app bundle against unexpected growth.

6.14.1.title: A clearer Overview
6.14.1.detail: Available wallet money stays separate from activity assigned to the selected reporting month. Expand Balance and reporting details to see wallet balances and how the two figures relate.

6.14.0.title: Android downloads in Settings
6.14.0.detail: Open Settings → Android app to see the latest published Android version, APK size, download link and release notes. The details refresh automatically when you open the section.

6.13.0.title: More reliable saving and Space access
6.13.0.detail: Stronger protection for offline retries, switching accounts, wallet reconciliation and shared Space access.

6.13.0.title: Stronger passkey protection
6.13.0.detail: Passkey setup stays tied to the confirming session, with safer checks during device registration and sign-in.

6.13.0.title: Recovery and service monitoring
6.13.0.detail: Encrypted recovery validation and a PostgreSQL restore quality gate have been strengthened. Service health now highlights repeated financial request failures without exposing records.

6.12.2.title: Consistent switches everywhere
6.12.2.detail: On and off switches now use one aligned design across settings, administrator controls and forms, including seasonal themes on browser and Android.

6.12.1.title: Header alignment across screens
6.12.1.detail: Page titles, action buttons and your account tag now stay neatly inside the header on browser and Android, including seasonal themes and narrow screens.

6.12.0.title: Clearer feedback conversations
6.12.0.detail: Follow private feedback discussions as a conversation with separate replies. Status changes save automatically, and existing replies are preserved.

6.12.0.title: A clearer passkey setup
6.12.0.detail: Google confirmation and device registration are now two clear steps, with a visible registration button and highlighted sign-in method.

6.12.0.title: Your account at a glance
6.12.0.detail: Your profile tag is now in the shared header. Sign out stays in the sidebar and is also the last option in More.

6.11.2.title: Saved feedback replies are easier to see
6.11.2.detail: Replies appear beneath the original feedback for administrators and recipients, separate from the editable reply box.

6.11.2.title: Clearer Google biometric enrollment
6.11.2.detail: Linked Google accounts can explicitly confirm with Google to register a passkey, including accounts that also have a Budgetly password. Enrollment no longer times out while completing Google confirmation.

6.11.2.title: Android Google return
6.11.2.detail: Google confirmation now uses an Android authentication tab and a verified HTTPS return, with a manual fallback for unsupported browsers.

6.11.1.title: Clearer feedback replies
6.11.1.detail: Saved administrator replies appear in your Feedback section with an unread indicator. Refresh feedback manually, keep replies during status changes, and avoid overwriting a newer answer.

6.11.1.title: Google and biometric sign-in
6.11.1.detail: Google-only accounts can confirm with Google before registering a device passkey. Google completion attempts to reopen Android automatically, with an Open Budgetly fallback, while browser popups close and continue sign-in securely.

6.11.0.title: A warm welcome to Budgetly
6.11.0.detail: An animated handwritten greeting introduces an optional guest workspace, account creation and sign-in. Password, Google, passkey and recovery flows remain available. Returning sessions open directly, and guest records can be reviewed before importing to an account.

6.11.0.title: Your greeting, your pace
6.11.0.detail: Settings → Look & feel → Welcome animation has its own speed dropdown and replay preview. The preference stays on this device after sign-out, works offline and respects reduced motion.

6.10.0.title: Seasonal worlds
6.10.0.detail: Original Halloween characters, varied autumn leaves, crystalline snowflakes, flowing glass rain, summer glimmers and spring butterflies bring the selected season across the workspace.

6.10.0.title: See-through seasonal surfaces
6.10.0.detail: Seasonal navigation and content surfaces now show the same atmosphere as the live preview. Adjust surface tint and animation speed, pause the preview, or turn seasons off to restore normal appearance. Motion and hidden-app preferences are respected.

6.9.1.title: Clearer Spaces directory
6.9.1.detail: Space rows now match the workspace design with clear creator, membership, role and currency details, an active indicator, and labelled management controls on browser and Android.

6.9.0.title: A clearer everyday workspace
6.9.0.detail: Simpler navigation, a More directory, and clearer Overview, Transactions, Wallets, Upcoming, Budgets, Bank Inbox and Spaces pages. Existing themes, wallpaper and wallet card designs are preserved.

6.9.0.title: Find and manage records more easily
6.9.0.detail: Search transactions directly, review wallet balances on demand, and use labelled actions for wallets and bank alerts. Space management and permissions keep their existing safeguards.

6.8.2.title: Seasonal atmosphere visibility
6.8.2.detail: Seasonal backgrounds now show through page surfaces like the preview. Rain has more drops, and preview motion scales to its own height.

6.8.1.title: Seasonal appearance
6.8.1.detail: Preview and apply Halloween, Rainy day, Winter, Summer, Autumn and Spring in Settings. Choose automatic hemisphere-aware seasons or a manual mood, with motion controls. Wallpaper and Space colours stay yours.

6.8.0.title: Owner-controlled Space deletion
6.8.0.detail: Owners can open Manage workspace → Delete Space, confirm the Space name, and remove the Space and its records. Personal records and other Spaces are preserved. Deleting the active Space returns you to Personal.

6.7.1.title: Upcoming entry popup
6.7.1.detail: Add and edit upcoming entries in a focused popup matching Transactions, with the existing fields, date and time pickers, scheduling options, and reminders. Save and Cancel stay in the popup footer.

6.7.0.title: Smoother background efficiency
6.7.0.detail: Background refresh respects inactivity and resumes when you return. Manual saving stays responsive.

6.7.0.title: Administrator efficiency controls
6.7.0.detail: Configure AI limits, notification delivery, backup spacing, and draft economy presets. Review operational counters and policy change history without exposing credentials or claiming estimated costs are actual provider bills.

6.7.0.title: Protected backup optimization
6.7.0.detail: Optional unchanged-data checks verify existing encrypted archives before skipping redundant uploads. Manual backups create fresh copies, stored backups are retained, and a fresh full copy is required at least weekly.

6.7.0.title: Scheduler switch appearance
6.7.0.detail: Corrected the scheduled-processing switch sizing and keyboard focus on browser and Android layouts.

6.6.1.title: Administrator toggle appearance
6.6.1.detail: The scheduled-processing switch now has a properly sized track, aligned thumb, and clear keyboard focus on browser and Android layouts.

6.6.0.title: More reliable scheduled and offline entries
6.6.0.detail: Scheduled saves are protected against duplicate retries and conflicting edits. Offline reopening and pending-entry controls have been strengthened, and scheduling guidance reflects the configured processing interval.

6.6.0.title: Administrator scheduler controls
6.6.0.detail: Pause or resume automatic scheduled processing and choose a check interval from 1 to 60 minutes. Existing records and manual saving remain available. Intentional pauses are clearly distinguished from service failures.

6.6.0.title: Stronger release verification
6.6.0.detail: Automated checks cover browser offline persistence, cross-tab queue coordination, PostgreSQL load and scheduled-entry concurrency using isolated synthetic data.

6.5.7.title: More reliable offline reopening
6.5.7.detail: When your device is offline, Budgetly opens its matching saved session directly instead of waiting for a network request. Entries saved on the device still need a successful sync before they are confirmed online.

6.5.7.title: Clearer service diagnostics
6.5.7.detail: Health checks preserve genuine outage failures and report only safe status metadata. Hosting quota exhaustion still requires a provider allowance reset or owner-approved upgrade.

6.5.6.title: Safer upcoming entries
6.5.6.detail: Retrying a scheduled save no longer creates duplicate plans. Conflicting edits ask you to reload the latest entry, and Viewer permissions apply consistently after a role change.

6.5.6.title: Clearer offline entry controls
6.5.6.detail: Offline entries distinguish unsent drafts from uploads that may already have reached your wallet, so discarding a local entry cannot silently race with syncing.

6.5.6.title: Browser offline and notifications together
6.5.6.detail: Browser push notifications and offline reopening now share one service worker, so enabling notifications no longer replaces offline support.

6.5.6.title: Continuous reliability checks
6.5.6.detail: Release checks now exercise concurrent PostgreSQL load and browser offline persistence using isolated synthetic records, without connecting to production data. Compatible dependency security patches are included.

6.5.5.title: Older backup compatibility
6.5.5.detail: Older backups with Space entries now recover their category labels correctly, with a clear explanation before you confirm restoration. Transaction amounts, dates and descriptions are preserved.

6.5.5.title: Non-destructive recovery compatibility
6.5.5.detail: Archive export and import reconcile legacy personal-category references into declared Spaces without rewriting live ledger rows. Cross-Space links and malformed archives remain rejected.

6.5.4.title: Safer saving and retries
6.5.4.detail: Incomplete server responses no longer look like confirmed saves. Queued entries stay tied to the correct account, with clearer pending, retry and review controls.

6.5.4.title: Clearer recovery and service status
6.5.4.detail: Admin distinguishes database recovery from independent backups, shows missing backup configuration and flags unconfirmed health after a failed refresh.

6.5.4.title: Stronger verification
6.5.4.detail: Completed encrypted backup runs include archive integrity metadata and can be verified together. New integration journeys cover sign-in, Space permissions, scheduled retries and restore.

6.5.3.title: Quieter when you step away
6.5.3.detail: Automatic background refreshes pause after 30 minutes without interaction and resume when you return. You stay signed in, with drafts and manual saving unchanged.

6.5.3.title: Lower idle database activity
6.5.3.detail: Idle-client polling no longer keeps requesting ledger, shared records, notes or reminder data. Neon can sleep once all database activity stops; due scheduled tasks and other active users can still wake it.

6.5.2.title: Clearer update messages
6.5.2.detail: Update and What's new popups now show changes relevant to your account.

6.5.2.title: Administrative release details
6.5.2.detail: Administrators see the full release notes, including operational changes hidden from regular account popups.

6.5.2.title: User sign-in ledger
6.5.2.detail: Open each user's sign-in history in Admin to see recorded sign-in times, last activity, device labels and session status. No location or IP tracking is added.

6.5.1.title: Reminder delivery reliability
6.5.1.detail: Adds the missing reminder receipt table safely to existing databases, restoring background reminder checks and allowing idle database checks to pause. Existing records and notification preferences are preserved.

6.5.0.title: Smarter background resource use
6.5.0.detail: Idle scheduler checks can skip the financial database while scheduled entries and reminders retain their due-time checks. User records remain in the same database.

6.5.0.title: Administrator resource controls
6.5.0.detail: Adjust client refresh, idle recovery rescans and database health probes from Admin, with validation and protection against conflicting changes.

6.5.0.title: Quieter, more efficient syncing
6.5.0.detail: Background reads pause while Budgetly is hidden or offline and avoid overlapping requests. Manual saving and refreshing remain available.

6.4.1.title: More reliable Android builds
6.4.1.detail: The release launcher shows live progress, saves local diagnostic logs, prevents overlapping builds and verifies the signed build before pushing source changes. Failed commands retain useful error details without treating normal warnings as build failures.

6.4.0.title: A clearer Settings experience
6.4.0.detail: Find account, appearance, currency, notifications, bank capture and recovery controls in distinct category pages. Stronger dividers and larger subheaders make each setting easier to recognize.

6.4.0.title: Motion throughout Budgetly
6.4.0.detail: Deliberate page, dialog and item transitions work across browser and Android, with reduced-motion and motion-off support.

6.4.0.title: Manage Spaces directly
6.4.0.detail: Open workspace management from your Spaces list without switching into it. Space details and member permissions save independently, with clear confirmation beside each action.

6.4.0.title: More readable wallet cards
6.4.0.detail: Visa and Mastercard marks are larger across Personal and Space wallets, with responsive sizing that keeps card contents readable.

6.3.2.title: Deployment reliability
6.3.2.detail: A smaller server bundle restores deployment compatibility. Release checks now verify the deployed backend and quality gates before publishing an Android update.

6.3.2.title: Consistent Space access checks
6.3.2.detail: Concurrent permission tests follow Space membership, verifying that actual removal and Viewer downgrades block further changes.

6.3.1.title: Consistent Space roles
6.3.1.detail: Managers can add, edit and delete Space transactions and upcoming entries, and manage wallets, budgets and categories, including records created by the owner. Viewers remain read-only.

6.3.1.title: Simpler membership
6.3.1.detail: Space owners now choose Viewer or Manager. Existing Contributors become Managers, with financial records and membership preserved.

6.3.0.title: Budgets that repeat
6.3.0.detail: Choose Repeat every month explicitly. Monthly spending refreshes automatically, while existing single-month budgets and all transactions stay intact.

6.3.0.title: Upcoming expense reminders
6.3.0.detail: Choose calendar days and a time, or a minute-based lead time. Notifications identify the expense. Android schedules local alerts; supported browsers can receive Web Push through the existing scheduler.

6.2.7.title: Support preferences
6.2.7.detail: Choose whether the coffee popup appears after sign-in. Administrators can also hide the support link in their own sidebar without changing it for anyone else.

6.2.6.title: Support Budgetly, your way
6.2.6.detail: A highlighted sidebar link keeps Ko-fi within reach. An optional sign-in prompt can be closed for the session and stays out of dialogs and data entry.

6.2.5.title: Support Budgetly
6.2.5.detail: An optional Buy me a coffee section in Settings links to the creator's Ko-fi page. Payments stay outside Budgetly and never change app access.

6.2.4.title: A clearer Notes library
6.2.4.detail: A phone-friendly folder drawer keeps folders in tidy rows, with counts and dedicated management controls.

6.2.4.title: Find and organize notes
6.2.4.detail: Browse the selected folder, sort by title or date, switch grid and list views, and search without losing your place.

6.2.3.title: Safer concurrent changes
6.2.3.detail: Stronger coordination protects workspace edits, permission changes and recovery snapshots when requests overlap.

6.2.3.title: Account and backup protection
6.2.3.detail: Aggregate reset limits reduce abuse, Google deletion and consent are coordinated, and backup failures appear in service health.

6.2.2.title: Safer Drive disconnect
6.2.2.detail: Pending Drive consent ends with its sign-in session. Permission-removal failures retry securely, with a clear pending state before reconnecting.

6.2.2.title: Safer account access
6.2.2.detail: Password resets and signing out all devices invalidate pending Google sign-ins. Stronger one-use reset links and request limits protect account actions.

6.2.2.title: More complete recovery
6.2.2.detail: Backups are checked before replacement. Space names and permissions restore consistently, with access details shown before confirmation.

6.2.2.title: Database reliability checks
6.2.2.detail: Automated PostgreSQL checks now cover simultaneous recording, bank approvals and scheduled posting. Synthetic encrypted database recovery has also been verified.

6.2.1.title: Reliability and recovery
6.2.1.detail: Stronger automated checks for Android alerts, bank capture, update safety and isolated backup recovery.

6.2.1.title: Service health
6.2.1.detail: Scheduler heartbeats and overdue detection help identify missed background processing. Sanitized error reports and a reload screen protect against blank pages.

6.2.0.title: Ask Budgetly groups
6.2.0.detail: Organize conversations into groups, move existing chats, and choose General or Group-only AI context in each group's settings.

6.2.0.title: Aligned and spacious layouts
6.2.0.detail: The footer follows the collapsed sidebar. Overview rows have comfortable padding, Settings has rounded edges, and both sidebars use clear arrow controls.

6.1.7.title: Cleaner page edges and navigation
6.1.7.detail: Rounded workspace edges, a compact page finder and collapsible desktop sidebar give your records more room.

6.1.7.title: Transaction actions stay visible
6.1.7.detail: The transaction header stays available while scrolling. Successful background sync no longer interrupts your screen.

6.1.6.title: Updates inside Budgetly
6.1.6.detail: Update prompts appear after sign-in, not on the login screen. Signed-in users get launch and resume checks without logging out.

6.1.6.title: What's new, once
6.1.6.detail: Installed release notes appear inside your account once, with update prompts waiting until you finish reading.

6.1.5.title: Persistent bank app choices
6.1.5.detail: Selected bank apps stay saved through session changes and capture resumes when the same account signs back in.

6.1.5.title: One bank setup location
6.1.5.detail: Manage Smart Bank Inbox in Settings. Old phone forwarding is retired; previously saved messages remain read-only.

6.1.4.title: Bank alert descriptions
6.1.4.detail: Read merchant, beneficiary and description details from bank notifications, including multiline alerts, instead of using a generic transfer label when details are available.

6.1.3.title: Clean Space categories
6.1.3.detail: Transaction, scheduled-entry and Bank Inbox category pickers no longer repeat migrated category names. Existing records retain their original category links.

6.1.3.title: Broader bank alert support
6.1.3.detail: Recognize signed credit/debit amounts alongside credited, debited, purchase, refund and transfer wording. Every bank entry still requires your review.

6.1.2.detail: Bank Inbox now recognizes signed amounts across bank formats and supported currency codes: plus for credits and minus for debits. Balance-only and security alerts are excluded, and every payment still requires review.

6.1.1.title: CBK bank alerts

6.1.0.title: Smart Bank Inbox
6.1.0.detail: Choose Android banking apps to capture payment alerts locally. Review and approve before anything is recorded.

6.1.0.title: Bank alerts in the right Space
6.1.0.detail: Map a bank app and card ending to a wallet in Personal or a Space. Move unmapped alerts before recording.

6.1.0.title: Safer bank-message review
6.1.0.detail: Detect purchases, income, refunds, transfers and ATM alerts without paid AI. Duplicate checks, category memory and security-code filtering keep you in control.

6.0.1.title: Properly sized wallet cards
6.0.1.detail: Wallets keep their bank-card proportions instead of expanding across the screen, in both Personal and Spaces.

6.0.0.title: Your spaces
6.0.0.detail: Keep Personal private and create separate shared spaces for home, trips or projects.

6.0.0.title: Safe shared-record migration
6.0.0.detail: Existing shared wallets and records move into Home Expense without changing their IDs or member permissions.

6.0.0.title: A complete workspace per space
6.0.0.detail: Switch between independent transactions, wallets, budgets, goals, analytics, planning and notes using familiar controls.

6.0.0.title: Owner-selected themes and roles
6.0.0.detail: Choose from six space colors and manage Viewer, Contributor and Manager access. Fresh sign-in starts in Personal.

5.15.0.title: Scheduled entry alerts
5.15.0.detail: Opt in to a short notification when your scheduled entry is recorded, even with Budgetly closed.

5.15.0.title: Clearer currencies
5.15.0.detail: Search currency names and codes, or enter a supported currency code manually.

5.15.0.title: Refined Settings and receipts
5.15.0.detail: Nested settings are easier to expand. Shared reference photos remain under More options when recording an entry.

5.15.0.title: Wallet notification icon
5.15.0.detail: Android and browser alerts now use a wallet icon.

5.14.1.title: Currency configuration
5.14.1.detail: Currency has its own Settings section and save action, preserving your selection across the workspace.

5.14.1.title: Background scheduling support
5.14.1.detail: A protected scheduled-entry runner supports independent server execution when configured by the administrator.

5.14.0.title: Reference photos while recording

5.14.0.title: Safer amount fields
5.14.0.detail: Scrolling over number inputs no longer changes your entered amounts.

5.14.0.title: Choose your currency
5.14.0.detail: Select your account currency in Settings, with consistent currency labels and decimal formatting across the workspace and exports. Existing amounts are not exchange-converted.

5.13.0.title: Smarter daily entry
5.13.0.detail: Common descriptions can prepare a wallet and category draft for your review.

5.13.0.title: Keep receipt photos
5.13.0.detail: Capture or attach a receipt inside transaction details. Receipts are included in backup and recovery.

5.13.0.title: Review bank matches
5.13.0.detail: Compare similar statement rows with existing records before importing.

5.13.0.title: Search and weekly review
5.13.0.detail: Turn phrases into filters, save searches, and review upcoming payments alongside weekly spending.

5.13.0.title: Safer recovery and forms
5.13.0.detail: Preview restores and protect unsaved edits when closing dialogs.

5.12.7.title: Review before restoring
5.12.7.detail: Preview backup record counts and confirm before replacing your workspace.

5.12.7.title: Safer forms
5.12.7.detail: Unsaved edits are protected when cancelling dialog footers, with improved keyboard focus handling.

5.12.6.title: More dependable update alerts
5.12.6.detail: Improved Android background delivery and release-triggered notifications.

5.12.6.title: Check notification delivery
5.12.6.detail: View registered devices and send a test notification from Settings.

5.12.5.title: A clearer Android update experience
5.12.5.detail: Review the version and changes in a focused popup before downloading the update.

5.12.5.title: Know what changed
5.12.5.detail: A What's new popup highlights the improvements after you sign in to an updated version.

5.12.5.title: Smoother, more accessible popups
5.12.5.detail: Rounded corners, a gentle slide-up animation, and support for reduced motion.

5.12.4.title: Safer backup restores
5.12.4.detail: Completed scheduled entries stay completed when you restore a backup.

5.12.4.title: Optional Google Drive backup
5.12.4.detail: Connect your Drive to save and restore your Budgetly records.

5.12.4.title: Clearer privacy information
5.12.4.detail: Read how your data is stored and which optional services use it.
